body: LlamaIndex is the leading document agent and OCR platform
plain_description: LlamaIndex helps businesses turn their documents and data into intelligent AI agents that can answer questions, extract information, and automate workflows. The big picture: Connect your data to AI so you can ask questions in plain language and get answers instantly. The bottom line: Faster decisions, automated document processing, and AI-powered insights from your existing files.
technical_description: LlamaIndex is a Python data framework for building LLM-powered applications with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and document processing. The framework provides data connectors for ingesting content from 130+ formats, indexing and graph structures for organizing data, and a query interface for retrieval and response synthesis. It supports over 300 integration packages for LLMs, embedding models, and vector stores, enabling flexible deployments with local or cloud-based providers. LlamaIndex includes modular components for document parsing, structured extraction, and agent orchestration via its workflow system.
title: LlamaIndex
